_doc: Station upgrades (D6.7). On arriving at a station other than the last, perStation upgrades are drawn at random from those not yet taken max times in this run; the team picks one by standing in its circle, or loses the pick when the countdown ends; either way the next level starts at once. Each upgrade adds its changes to settings from config/game.json ('section.key': amount, negative to lower). The label is shown with the first change's value now and after, followed by the optional unit. A wagon upgrade ('wagon': storage, crafting or dynamite) joins the back of the train at once, and is offered only while the train has room (each storage wagon holds storageMax more of each resource; each crafting wagon trackMax more track and makes a pair alongside the others). 'needs' names an upgrade that must have been taken first in the run. A new run starts from the room's settings without them.
